modes.definition_zh: 将军事驻防与农业生产相结合，通过屯垦实现边疆地区的经济自给和国防安全，形成'兵农合一'的稳定机制。
modes.definition_en: Combine military garrison with agricultural production, achieve economic self-sufficiency and national defense security in border regions through Tunten, forming a stable mechanism of 'soldier-farmer integration'.
process_zh: 将作战部队转为农业生产部队
在边疆地区开展大规模垦荒
建立军事化农业生产组织
实现边疆地区的经济自给
形成国防与民生结合的长效机制
process_en: Convert combat troops to agricultural production units
Launch large-scale reclamation in border regions
Achieve economic self-sufficiency in border regions
Form long-term mechanisms combining national defense and livelihood
modes.application_zh: 边疆地区的长效稳定机制、军事化建设与民生开发结合、复杂政治环境下的区域社会改造
modes.application_en: Long-term stability mechanisms in border regions, combining militarized construction with livelihood development, regional social transformation in complex political environments
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 现代边疆治理、军民融合发展战略
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 战略统筹、资源整合、组织创新
representative_cases_zh: 创建新疆生产建设兵团
representative_cases_en: Founding Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps
modes.key_quote_en: Tunten Shubian, protect borders and consolidate nation

modes.definition_zh: 建立一种特殊的组织形式——生产建设兵团，既是军事单位又是生产单位，实现国防建设与经济发展的有机统一。
modes.definition_en: Establish a special organizational form - Production and Construction Corps, which is both a military unit and a production unit, achieving organic unity of national defense construction and economic development.
process_zh: 明确兵团的双重职能定位
建立军事化的组织架构
实施农业现代化的生产技术
形成自我循环的经济体系
实现社会稳定与国家安全的统一
process_en: Clarify the dual function positioning of the corps
Achieve unity of social stability and national security
modes.application_zh: 大型国有企业改革、军民融合产业发展、边疆区域治理
modes.application_en: Large state-owned enterprise reform, military-civilian integration industry development, border regional governance
modes.modern_parallel_zh: 现代企业集团治理、军民融合创新
modes.thinking_skill_zh: 制度设计、组织创新、系统思维
modes.key_quote_en: Integration of party, government, military and enterprise
